CVE-2026-53613.title: util-linux: util-linux: TOCTOU in the mount program via ancestor directory swap on target path
CVE-2026-53613.description: When an /etc/fstab entry is configured with the user or users option, mount(8) validates the target path before performing the mount syscall, creating a Time-of-Check-Time-of-Use (TOCTOU) window. A local unprivileged user with write access to an ancestor directory of the mount target can swap that directory to redirect the mount to an arbitrary root-owned location, potentially escalating privileges to root.
